hits.name: Full-Grain Leather Belt
hits.description: The Waybound Full-Grain Leather Belt in walnut brown is a durable travel essential crafted from solid full-grain leather with an antique brass buckle. Built to last through years of adventures, this timeless accessory combines functionality with classic style.
hits.imagePrompt: Flat lay full-grain leather belt in walnut brown with brass buckle, coiled, travel-ready styling, artisanal craftsmanship

hits.name: Leather Belt with Brass Buckle
hits.description: This saddle-tan leather belt features a timeless brass buckle and is crafted from durable full-grain leather. Perfect for adding a warm, classic touch to any wardrobe.
hits.imagePrompt: women's leather belt in saddle-tan full-grain leather with prominent brass buckle, durable construction, product photography on white background
